stories.title: Streetwear gains traction in India
stories.summary: Streetwear in India has transitioned from a niche hobby to a primary form of self-expression. Once distant from luxury houses, the style now benefits from major label collaborations. Fans now track drops, queue for pop-ups, and debate the value of hoodies. The hobby has officially become a lifestyle.

stories.title: Ibrahim Ali Khan maintains a classic aesthetic
stories.summary: Ibrahim Ali Khan is developing his own style as he continues his career in Bollywood. His approach focuses on classic, uncomplicated pieces rather than borrowing directly from his father's wardrobe. He prioritizes sharp tailoring for formal occasions and comfort for daily wear, keeping his personal aesthetic consistent.

stories.title: Prince William wears Indian label KARDO in Mumbai
stories.summary: Prince William appeared in Mumbai wearing a navy-blue Nehru-style jacket by Indian label KARDO. The garment was a last-minute addition to his wardrobe for the three-day visit. The sleeveless silhouette served as a notable fashion statement during his first public appearance in the city on November 16.

stories.title: Royal couple highlights sustainable fashion in Mumbai
stories.summary: Prince William and Kate Middleton continued their three-day India visit on November 16 with engagements at Ballard Estate and the Mumbai Metro. The Princess wore a cobalt-blue dress while the Prince opted for navy tailoring. Their schedule focused on sustainable urban development and local community engagement.

stories.title: Kate Middleton debuts rice-straw bag at Earthshot Prize
stories.summary: At the 2026 Earthshot Prize in Mumbai, Kate Middleton carried a bespoke DeMellier bag made from rice-straw by-products. Created by London-based SurpRice, the material is intended as a sustainable alternative to synthetics. The Princess paired the accessory with a re-worn Roksanda dress to highlight innovation in materials.

stories.title: Royal couple begins Mumbai visit for Earthshot Prize
stories.summary: Prince William and Catherine, Princess of Wales, have arrived in Mumbai for the sixth annual Earthshot Prize Summit. The three-day visit marks their first joint trip to India since 2016. The schedule includes various engagements celebrating sustainability, innovation, and the ongoing relationship between India and the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Kate Middleton Recreates Memorable Cricket-in-Heels Moment From 2016 India Visit 10 Years Later - InStyle
Kate Middleton re-wears Roksanda dress in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales wore a cobalt-blue Roksanda midi dress during a visit to Mumbai’s Vidhan Bhavan Metro Station on November 16. The garment, previously worn to Wimbledon, was paired with other familiar pieces. The royal couple continues their three-day tour with a focus on sustainable infrastructure.

stories.title: Royal couple arrives in Mumbai for three-day visit
stories.summary: Prince William and Princess Catherine arrived in Mumbai for their first joint state visit in four years. The Princess debuted a pistachio-green Veronica Beard blazer for a street cricket engagement before changing into a cobalt-blue Roksanda dress. The couple is scheduled to remain in the city for three days.

stories.title: Kate Middleton wears re-worn Roksanda dress in Mumbai
stories.summary: Princess Kate wore a cobalt-blue Roksanda midi dress for her Mumbai engagements on Monday, including a ride on the city's Metro. The dress was previously worn to the 2025 Wimbledon men’s singles championship. The Princess opted for the familiar piece during her first joint India visit in a decade.

stories.title: Princess Kate chooses sustainable theme for India tour
stories.summary: Princess Kate began her Mumbai visit on November 16 wearing a pistachio-green Veronica Beard blazer and white trousers. The outfit was selected for a game of street cricket ahead of the Earthshot Prize. Jewelry experts noted her green gemstones provided a thematic connection to the trip's sustainability focus.

stories.title: India International Trade Fair hosts handloom exhibition
stories.summary: The India International Trade Fair 2026 features a special exhibition themed Vikas Aur Virasat at Bharat Mandapam. Organised by the National Handloom Development Corporation, the pavilion includes 200 stalls representing artisans from 21 states. The event aims to provide direct market access for weavers and craftspeople.

stories.title: Tel Aviv designers experiment with recycled materials
stories.summary: A new generation of Israeli designers is focusing on recycled fabrics and bold silhouettes at Tel Aviv Fashion Week. The local design community continues to navigate challenges including geographical isolation and limited material access. Designers are currently prioritizing reinvention and fantasy to push beyond traditional industry conventions.

stories.title: Zara Tindall attends Cheltenham November Meeting
stories.summary: Zara Tindall attended the November Meeting at Cheltenham over the weekend, showcasing two country-chic ensembles. The King's niece was joined by fashion designer Jade Holland Cooper. The event, a staple of the winter racing season, saw Tindall noted for her approach to traditional British heritage dressing.

stories.title: Sienna Miller reflects on two decades of style
stories.summary: Actress Sienna Miller, 44, continues to influence fashion trends while maintaining a high-profile public life. Her career spans two decades, beginning with her status as a poster girl for boho-chic in the early 2000s. Her personal history has frequently intersected with significant media attention and public scrutiny.

stories.title: Jennifer Lawrence wears Dior for Hunger Games premiere
stories.summary: Jennifer Lawrence attended the New York premiere of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping wearing a black silk coat from Dior’s Pre-Fall 2026 collection. The garment featured floral embroidery, a detail noted for its thematic connection to the film franchise's history with floral motifs.

stories.title: Elle Fanning wears custom Givenchy in New York
stories.summary: Elle Fanning wore a custom Givenchy gown by Sarah Burton to the New York premiere of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. The design incorporated beauty products including compact mirrors and powder puffs. The actress stated the look was intended to embrace the eccentricity of Effie Trinket.

stories.title: Elizabeth Debicki attends ELLE Women in Hollywood event
stories.summary: Elizabeth Debicki wore a sleeveless white gown to the ELLE Women in Hollywood event in Beverly Hills. The actress paired the minimalist silhouette with a feathered oversize clutch. Debicki, an honoree at the event, discussed her recent career trajectory and lessons learned within the film industry.

stories.title: Julianne Moore wears Ralph Lauren to ELLE event
stories.summary: Julianne Moore attended ELLE’s Women in Hollywood event on November 16. The honoree walked the red carpet in a Ralph Lauren coat and a sparkling choker. She is currently promoting her upcoming film, The Debut, which features director Jesse Eisenberg. The coat was worn over a dress.

stories.title: Florence Pugh wears Ralph Lauren to ELLE event
stories.summary: Honoree Florence Pugh attended ELLE’s 2026 Women in Hollywood event in a sculpted blue Ralph Lauren gown. The Dune: Part Three actress accessorized with Bulgari jewelry. She recently appeared in the magazine’s portfolio alongside several other honorees, noting she is learning to better protect herself.

stories.title: Carrie Coon wears Ralph Lauren to ELLE event
stories.summary: Carrie Coon attended ELLE’s Women in Hollywood event in Los Angeles on Monday. The actress wore a plunging black velvet Ralph Lauren gown with a floor-length train and gold statement earrings by Fred Leighton. She is currently promoting her new film, The Liberation.

stories.title: Penélope Cruz wears Ralph Lauren to ELLE event
stories.summary: Honoree Penélope Cruz attended ELLE’s 2026 Women in Hollywood event in a red Ralph Lauren gown and gold earrings. The actress, who posed with co-star Seth Rogen, expects to complete her directorial debut next year. The documentary focuses on a subject she has been researching for decades.

stories.title: Rosalind Eleazar wears Ralph Lauren to ELLE event
stories.summary: Rosalind Eleazar attended ELLE’s 2026 Women in Hollywood event in Los Angeles on November 16. The Slow Horses actress wore a tailored Ralph Lauren ensemble consisting of a patterned beige tailcoat, a ruffled blouse, and dark trousers. She was recognized as an honoree at the celebration.

stories.title: Léa Seydoux wears Louis Vuitton to Governors Awards
stories.summary: Léa Seydoux attended the 2026 Governors Awards in an off-the-shoulder red crêpe jersey gown by Louis Vuitton featuring an oversized satin bow. The actor is currently promoting her new film, Gentle Monster. She described the ceremony as a night to celebrate the craft behind the films.

stories.title: India diamond exports rise in October
stories.summary: India’s polished diamond exports rose 10.5 percent to $1.13 billion in October. The increase follows three months of decline and is attributed to the timing of Diwali, which fell in November this year rather than October, allowing factories to operate for a longer period.

stories.title: Titan opens beYon lab-grown diamond store in Bengaluru
stories.summary: Titan has opened its seventh beYon lab-grown diamond store in Bengaluru. The brand showcases over 1,250 designs in BIS hallmarked gold, including modular pieces and various diamond cuts. Pricing for the collection is largely concentrated below INR 1 lakh. The expansion follows earlier launches in Mumbai and Delhi.

stories.title: Michael Rubin gifts rare diamond engagement ring
stories.summary: Fanatics CEO Michael Rubin proposed to model Camille Fishel with a 13-carat D-flawless Type 2A Golconda-type diamond ring. Designed by Lorraine Schwartz, the stone is described as one of the rarest in the world. Only 2 percent of all diamonds fall into this specific category.

stories.title: Industrial metal passes as gold in Japan
stories.summary: Stores across Japan have been tricked by jewelry made from industrial metal plated to resemble gold. Tantalum is being used for the replicas due to its similar density, which makes it difficult for shops to distinguish the fake items from authentic gold jewelry using standard checks.

stories.title: Bulgari brings Eclettica collection to Palm Beach
stories.summary: Bulgari has brought its Eclettica high jewelry collection to the United States for the first time. The collection, which debuted in Milan, includes 15 transformable pieces and over 50 creations valued at $1 million or more. The launch was marked by a boutique opening on Worth Avenue.

stories.summary: Bulgari has brought its Eclettica high jewelry collection to the United States for the first time. The collection, which debuted in Milan, includes 15 transformable pieces and over 50 creations valued at $1 million or more. The launch was marked by a boutique opening on Worth Avenue.

Titan Eye+ partners with Marvel for running events
stories.summary: Titan Eye+ has partnered with Marvel for The Unrivaled Run, an immersive event series in Bengaluru, Mumbai and Delhi. The collaboration aims to help participants step into the world of their favourite superheroes through fitness and community. The eyewear brand is now officially associated with the Marvel universe.

stories.title: The search for the season's it-bag
stories.summary: Fashion trends often rely on social media visibility to crown a new it-bag. While runway appearances and influencer endorsements frequently drive demand, the distinction between a personal preference and a must-have item remains subjective. Guidance from luxury sourcing experts is now a standard part of the process.

stories.title: Designer bags at Nordstrom for fall and winter
stories.summary: The fashion calendar suggests fall and winter are distinct, but retailers are positioning handbags as year-round accessories. Slouchy silhouettes are currently marketed as the primary trend for the 2026 season. Apparently, a suede shoulder bag is expected to survive the transition from pumpkin spice season to winter.

stories.title: Classic men's watch brands for beginners
stories.summary: Classic men's watches are often described as status symbols that can be intimidating for newcomers. Experts suggest that the market is frequently either over-hyped or overlooked. The goal is to provide entry-level information for those who find the traditional approach to wrist candy somewhat excessive.

Brooks Nader wears $21 Amazon tennis bracelet
stories.summary: Brooks Nader wore a Pavoi 14K gold plated tennis bracelet to a recent event in Manhattan. The item is currently the top-selling women's tennis bracelet on Amazon with over 32,000 reviews. It retails for less than $21, proving that fine jewelry aesthetics are now available for under $40.

stories.title: India and Egypt discuss trade agreement
stories.summary: India and Egypt are forming a Joint Working Group to explore a potential free trade agreement. Both nations identified textiles and cotton as key areas for cooperation. India is seeking high-quality cotton imports to support its domestic textile industry, following a period of balanced apparel trade between the countries.

stories.title: Centuries of Egypt-India textile ties celebrated at India Fashion Night in Cairo - City Lights - Life & Style - Ahram On
Fashion show in Benin highlights China-Africa ties
stories.summary: Designers from China and West Africa gathered in Cotonou for a fashion show themed Harmony of Cultures through Fashion. The event featured traditional and contemporary designs from Benin, Togo, Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire. It was intended to celebrate cultural connections and friendship between the participating regions.

stories.title: Khmer Enterprise awards garment and textile innovators
stories.summary: Khmer Enterprise held an award ceremony for the fourth season of its garment and textile competition. The program aims to highlight technical advancement and creative ingenuity within Cambodia's apparel sector. The organization claims to strengthen the local fashion ecosystem by providing a platform for emerging entrepreneurs.

stories.title: AAFA study explores textile recycling in CAFTA-DR
stories.summary: A new study by the AAFA examines the potential for textile-to-textile recycling in the CAFTA-DR region. The report cites geographic proximity to the US and established manufacturing capacity as advantages for nearshoring. However, the region faces structural challenges in scaling these recycling capabilities for the current market.

stories.title: UK clothing exports see slight September increase
stories.summary: United Kingdom clothing exports rose slightly in September 2026 to reach £*** million. Despite this monthly increase, Q3 exports declined compared to previous periods. Full-year 2025 shipments also saw a decrease across clothing, fabric and fibre sectors, according to data from the Office for National Statistics.

stories.title: Bangladesh trade deficit with India reaches $7,860 million
stories.summary: Bangladesh recorded a trade deficit of $7,860 million with India in the 2025 fiscal year. Exports to India totaled $1,764.23 million against imports of $9,624.10 million. The country also reported smaller trade shortfalls with Pakistan, Afghanistan and Bhutan, while maintaining surpluses with other neighbouring markets.

stories.title: EU spending on clothing and footwear increases
stories.summary: EU household spending on clothing and footwear rose by 2.7 per cent in 2025 after adjusting for inflation. This growth rate accelerated from 0.9 per cent in 2024. Overall household consumption growth across the region remained more modest, easing to 1.6 per cent during the same period.

stories.title: North India cotton yarn prices rise
stories.summary: Cotton yarn prices in Delhi have increased by ₹3-5 per kg. Spinning mills are raising prices to cover raw material costs and report minimal pressure to sell domestically due to export commitments. Consumer industries argue that the price hikes are disproportionate to the underlying market conditions.

stories.title: Ethical fashion market sees growth
stories.summary: The ethical fashion sector is expanding as consumers show more interest in the environmental and social impacts of their clothing. This shift, combined with new business models and sustainability initiatives, is driving industry growth. The market is currently exploring how to turn this awareness into long-term commercial success.

stories.title: Global Fashion Summit addresses industry shifts
stories.summary: The Global Fashion Summit in Copenhagen is framing the current state of the industry under the theme of business not as usual. The event aims to address how climate, biodiversity, and resource crises are forcing a rewrite of the rules for fashion production, finance, and material value.

stories.title: The battle over fashion’s waste crisis - Financial Times
Next-gen materials face commercial hurdles
stories.summary: Scaling next-gen materials remains a challenge despite an increase in early commercial relationships. A 2026 report found that every brand surveyed now considers performance and aesthetics a significant obstacle to adoption, while investors point to supply chain integration. The industry is still working to move beyond isolated pilots.

stories.title: Calls for H&M to end clothing waste
stories.summary: Campaigners are urging H&M to make a public commitment to stop destroying unsold clothing. While the retailer includes waste reduction in its sustainability goals, critics note that millions of items are produced annually and often end up as pollution. The company has yet to ban the practice entirely.

stories.title: Fast fashion promotions return for the holidays
stories.summary: As Black Friday approaches, large fashion retailers are again using discounts and time-bound marketing to drive sales. Critics argue that these strategies profit from supply chain exploitation while avoiding transparency on sustainability. Consumers are being encouraged to consider the nuance of their spending during the festive season.

stories.title: University students turn to sustainable fashion
stories.summary: Students at the University are increasingly seeking sustainable clothing alternatives to keep up with trends while managing academic and social demands. Fast fashion remains a popular, cost-effective choice for many, though environmental agencies continue to highlight the industry's impact on resources and waste.

stories.title: The dark value of fashion
Garment workers reflect on fast fashion production
stories.summary: A garment worker in Pakistan identified denim styles in an American Eagle advertisement as products she had previously manufactured. The industry continues to face scrutiny over the real cost of production, as the global marketing of these garments often contrasts sharply with the conditions in manufacturing hubs.

David Jones to close 19 stores
stories.summary: Receivers have confirmed the closure of 19 David Jones stores across Australia and New Zealand as part of an urgent restructure. The 188-year-old retailer recently entered voluntary administration amid reports of unpaid supplier invoices and rent. The management plan was developed prior to the company entering receivership.

stories.title: Richemont jewellery sales increase
stories.summary: Richemont reported an 18 percent year-on-year sales increase for its jewellery brands, including Cartier and Van Cleef and Arpels, reaching 9.15 billion euros. The company attributed this growth to strong performance in Japan, the Americas, and the Asia Pacific region, which helped offset weaker results in China.

stories.title: Watches of Switzerland reports revenue growth
stories.summary: Watches of Switzerland saw revenue rise 15 percent to 974 million pounds in the first half of the financial year. Growth in the US market, bolstered by the acquisition of Deutsch and Deutsch, helped drive the results. The company remains satisfied with performance despite ongoing global economic conditions.

Fermat raises $8 million to expand AI fashion platform
stories.summary: Barcelona-based Fermat has raised $8 million in seed funding to open a New York office and expand its software into garment production. The platform, which serves over 350 customers, is launching a tool to convert designs into factory-ready specifications. The software is evolving beyond design visualisation.

Fermat secures $8 million seed round for AI production tools
stories.summary: Fermat has raised $8 million in seed funding to expand its AI platform from design visualisation into full garment production. The company, which counts Asos and New Look among its 350 customers, plans to use the capital to open a New York office and launch automated production specifications.

stories.title: Zalando eyes retail media for higher profit margins
stories.summary: European e-commerce giant Zalando is pushing into retail media, placing advertisements across its own websites and apps to boost profits. The company aims to replicate the high margins seen by competitors like Amazon. Fashion giants are finding that selling space is easier than selling clothes.

stories.title: Google Photos expands virtual closet feature
stories.summary: Google Photos has expanded its Clueless-inspired Wardrobe tool to iOS users in the U.S., India, and Brazil. The feature uses computer vision and generative AI to scan photo libraries and categorize garments. The company says this marks a turning point for AI-driven personal styling at scale.

stories.title: J. Crew launches AI-powered style advisor
stories.summary: J. Crew has introduced a desktop digital assistant developed in partnership with Anthropic. The tool aims to provide a styling experience that goes beyond individual product searches. Retailers are increasingly looking to software to tell customers what they should be wearing.

stories.title: Nike teases innovation pipeline amid turnaround efforts
stories.summary: Nike is preparing a slate of upcoming products as it attempts to address turnaround fatigue. The pipeline includes a revamp of the company's training category and a new manufacturing process for its Air franchise. The activewear giant is looking for ways to make its products feel new.

stories.title: Dillard’s reports modest sales growth
stories.summary: Dillard’s recorded a 1% increase in retail sales and comps during the third quarter compared to last year. While growth remains slow, the department store noted that the results beat analyst expectations. The retailer continues to hold onto market share in a difficult environment.

stories.title: Google Maps adds holiday travel features
stories.summary: Google Maps is rolling out four new features, including custom itineraries and route tips, ahead of the holiday travel season. The company is expanding its Ask Maps tool to 30 countries. AAA expects 73 million Americans to travel by car for Thanksgiving, and they will all have navigation.

stories.title: Dreamteam raises $53 million for AI-native CRM
stories.summary: AI-native CRM startup Dreamteam has raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel, and Premji Invest. Founded in 2025 by former Freshworks executives, the company is building a platform designed to understand customer context and deploy AI coworkers. The CRM was apparently in need of an upgrade.

stories.title: Boden selects OneStock to manage inventory
stories.summary: Boden has partnered with OneStock to unify its inventory and order management systems as it scales its international operations. The brand, which is one of Shopify’s largest EMEA clients, sought a centralised platform to manage complex order flows. Modernising the back office is now a priority for expansion.

stories.title: International brands target India’s smaller cities
stories.summary: International brands are expanding into Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities in India, citing modern shopping centres and rising demand. Chandigarh and Mangaluru currently lead in brand density, while Lucknow holds the most shopping centre stock. Retailers are finding that the goldmine is no longer just in the metros.

stories.title: V-Bazaar Retail expands to 130 stores
stories.summary: Value fashion retailer V-Bazaar Retail has expanded its network to over 130 stores across 95 cities. The company is focusing on festive demand in smaller markets through its Festive Fashion Swag campaign. Most of the new locations are situated in Tier-2, Tier-3, and Tier-4 towns.

stories.title: India's smallcap apparel companies expand brand portfolios
stories.summary: CareEdge ratings estimates the Indian apparel retail market at 9.3 lakh crore in FY25, projecting growth to 16 lakh crore by FY30. Organised retail currently holds 41 percent of the market. Companies are now betting that premiumisation and expansion into smaller cities will keep the clothes moving.

stories.title: Rene Caovilla opens first India boutique in New Delhi
stories.summary: Italian luxury footwear brand Rene Caovilla has launched its first boutique in New Delhi. The expansion marks the brand's latest entry into the Indian retail market.

Lancaster boutique wins two national retail awards
stories.summary: Renes, a family-run boutique in Lancaster, won Resilient Retailer of the Year and Retailer Event of the Year at the national fashion retail awards. Founded in 1955, the business was recognised for its longevity and a fashion show held at Lancaster Castle. History remains a marketable asset.
